tagline: Auto-rent Mining Rig Rentals deals from your NAS
description:
MRR AutoRent scans MiningRigRentals for affordable hashrate deals, builds
multi-currency candidates, and can auto-rent when the worker is enabled.

First run:

1. Open the app — complete the setup wizard (API key + secret)
2. Ensure Rent = Write on your MRR API key
3. Pick a pool profile, tune filters, then enable AutoRent

Runs as a Next.js web UI plus a dedicated worker sharing SQLite under
`/DATA/AppData`.

This app can spend your MRR balance when the worker is running — keep
cooldown and filters conservative until you trust the setup.
author: Carpathians

tips.before_install:
You need a MiningRigRentals API key with **Rent = Write**.

The worker can spend your MRR balance. Start with conservative filters
and cooldown. Dashboard is on port **8742**.
